# Session Start (Strict)

Use this at the start of a new context.

```text
Continue JTetris in strict mode.
1) Read AGENTS.md, the active spec, and the latest entry in doc/specs/context-pack.md.
2) Output: goal (1-2 lines), exact file allowlist, and out-of-scope list.
3) Implement only the next smallest checklist step.
4) Do not refactor, rename, move files, or change dependencies unless explicitly requested.
5) End with: what changed, what remains, and whether mvn clean test was run.
```
